text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: Canary anomaly detected for rollout 'weights-v3' in us-west-2a. Error rate: malformed-token responses 15% (baseline 0.2%). Auto-canary paused. Escalate if customer impact > small. https://metrics.redwood/alerts/6576543210

alice_sre: seeing a clear spike in tokenizer errors in the canary logs, looks like vocab mismatches + tokenization exceptions.

bob_platform: confirmed. Model weights manifest points at weightset:v3-bundle-2026-03-16, but tokenizer config on the serving hosts is still using tokenizer:v2 (config drift).

erin_support: we've received two customer tickets about cut-off responses and garbled tokens in the last 10m, priority-high for those customers.

carlos_oncall: @channel I'm taking this. High level: canary paused automatically, but some traffic still landed. Need fast mitigation: either flip feature-flag to route away from v3 or rollback weightset alias. Which is faster?

alice_sre: flip FF is fastest. Flag name: "use_weights_v3". If we set to false it should route traffic back to v2 legacy pool.

dana_pm: customers affected include 3 enterprise tenants on the canary cohort. We should notify them if we do a rollback.

frank_eng: I can flip the flag. Command via ops-ui or API: ```
# feature flag API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://ops.redwood/api/flags/use_weights_v3/set -d '{"value":false}'
```

alice_sre: also let's revoke any auto-updates: the config service pushed tokenizer:v2->v3 mapping to 4 hosts. We need to restart config agent or revert config change.

carlos_oncall: frank, execute the FF flip and then run quick smoke on canary endpoints. If error rate drops start wider rollback plan.

frank_eng: flipping flag now. ``POST /api/flags/use_weights_v3/set -> 200 OK`` :white_check_mark:

frank_eng: smoke run results: base generation endpoints show token error rate dropping to 0.5% on canary population. Logs show tokenizer mismatch errors decreased.

erin_support: posting update to the two impacted customers: "We're investigating a degraded experience linked to a recent model rollout; routing back to previous model now and will follow up with details."

bob_platform: I'm starting a controlled alias rollback for the artifact: ``weight_alias promote --from v3-bundle-2026-03-16 --to v2-stable``. Will push a canary verify wave.

alice_sre: confirm config agent restarts scheduled. Running ``systemctl restart redwood-config-agent`` on nodes that received tokenizer:v3 config.

carlos_oncall: status check: FF flipped, smoke looks good, alias rollback in progress, customers notified. Next steps: full rollback if alias promotion finishes cleanly. Notify SRE lead and schedule post-incident review.

dana_pm: please include timeline and customer impact in follow-up. Add who was paged and actions taken.

frank_eng: alias promotion completed. Canary metrics: malformed tokens back to baseline (0.15%). No new customer tickets in 12m.

alice_sre: capturing forensic notes: root cause appears to be config drift between tokenizer versions + artifact tag mismatch (weights tagged v3, but tokenizer rollout partially deployed). Will add config hash diffs.

erin_support: closing immediate customer-facing alerts after confirmation. Will reopen if any regressions.

carlos_oncall: handing off to alice_sre for postmortem and long-term mitigation. Assigning follow-up actions: (1) harden deploy checks to verify tokenizer+weights compatibility, (2) block auto-promote when tokenizer config diverges, (3) add a preflight canary sampler that validates token-level sanity.

alice_sre: copying action items and will run root-cause meeting in 2 hours. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation applied (feature-flag flip + alias rollback). Severity: Sev2. Duration: ~25m. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled.
